FerryWellCo is an Amsterdam team that works with research on heat, fine-particle pollution (PM2.5) and outdoor activity. GOTime helps you compare the heat and PM2.5 outlook for a planned run, walk, ride or group session. Start at the [homepage](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/) or [try a sample planning scenario](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/demo/).

See [applications](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/applications/) for outdoor work, partner apps, facilities and insurance. The [science page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/science/) explains the research and its limits. The [privacy page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/privacy/) describes the email contact form.
